theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.Split.bring_realisation :
∃ (s : SplitBringCone ℝ) (u : SplitBringCone ℝ) (φ : ℝ) (r : ℝ), φ = 2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 5) ∧ r = 2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 4) ∧ φ * φ = φ + 1 ∧ r * r = 2 ∧ 0 < φ ∧ 0 < r ∧ rnorm s = 1 ∧ rnorm u = 1 ∧ rtr s = 0 ∧ rtr u = φ ∧ rtr (s * u) = r

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.Split.bring_x_y {R : Type u_1} [Field R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {s u : SplitBringCone R} {φ r : R} (hφ : φ * φ = φ + 1) (hr : r * r = 2) (hφ0 : 0 < φ) (hr0 : 0 < r) (hNs : rnorm s = 1) (hNu : rnorm u = 1) (hTs : rtr s = 0) (hTu : rtr u = φ) (hTsu : rtr (s * u) = r) :
rnorm (s * (u * u)) = 1 ∧ rnorm (u * u * s) = 1 ∧ rtr (s * (u * u)) = φ * r ∧ rtr (u * u * s) = φ * r ∧ 2 < φ * r ∧ rnorm (s * (u * u) * (u * u * s) - u * u * s * (s * (u * u))) = 1 - φ ∧ 1 - φ ≠ 0

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.Split.bring_relations {K : Type u_2} [CommRing K] {s u : SplitBringCone K} {φ r : K} (hφ : φ * φ = φ + 1) (hr : r * r = 2) (hNs : rnorm s = 1) (hNu : rnorm u = 1) (hTs : rtr s = 0) (hTu : rtr u = φ) (hTsu : rtr (s * u) = r) :
s * s = -1 ∧ u ^ 5 = -1 ∧ (s * u) ^ 4 = -1

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.Split.det_one_x_y_xy {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (x y : SplitBringCone R) :

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.Split.rnorm_comm_eq {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (x y : SplitBringCone R) :
rnorm (x * y - y * x) = 4 * rnorm x * rnorm y - rnorm y * rtr x ^ 2 - rnorm x * rtr y ^ 2 - rtr (x * y) ^ 2 + rtr x * rtr y * rtr (x * y)

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.Split.rtr_conj {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (a B : SplitBringCone R) :
rtr (a * B * a) = rtr a * rtr (B * a) - rnorm a * rtr B

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.Split.rtr_mul_mul_self {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (a b : SplitBringCone R) :

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.Split.rtr_mul_self {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (x : SplitBringCone R) :
rtr (x * x) = rtr x ^ 2 - 2 * rnorm x

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.Split.rtr_mul_comm {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (x y : SplitBringCone R) :

theorem QOU.Tetraplectic.Split.mul_self_eq {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (x : SplitBringCone R) :
